header.title: Backend Engineer
header.subtitle: Pursuing clarity in an intricate world

about.summary: Backend engineer who builds systems that help field data flow accurately and reliably in a global spatial AI SaaS for construction and facilities. Worked on asset management, construction progress tracking, and AI preprocessing pipelines while handling data inconsistency and high-volume event processing problems. When a needed feature or validation layer does not exist, builds it and follows the problem through.
highlights: Built a backend domain for managing building assets in a hierarchical structure, making complex field assets easier to create, query, and update consistently
Built a validation system that automatically diagnoses consistency between design models and on-site progress data, resolving recurring inconsistencies for enterprise customers
Stabilized the progress-event delivery layer where events were delayed under traffic spikes, and rolled the change out gradually across 6 regions
Scaled an AI image generation service from zero to 1M+ monthly requests, cutting infrastructure costs by 20% and CDN costs by 80%+

experience.description: Global spatial AI SaaS company that connects building 3D design models with on-site 360° capture data to track construction progress and asset status. Worked on backend areas that help field data be collected, validated, and delivered reliably, including asset management, progress-data validation, event delivery, and AI preprocessing.

achievements.title: Built a Field Asset Management Domain
details: Built a backend domain for creating, querying, and updating building assets in a hierarchical structure, including Bulk APIs for large imports
Added validation for UUID duplicates, self-loops, and circular references so invalid import files could not corrupt asset hierarchy data
Implemented operational features such as asset change history, field inheritance, attachments, comments, and thumbnails

achievements.title: Improved Reliability of Construction Progress Data
details: Built a validation system that automatically detects inconsistencies between building 3D design models and on-site progress data
Classified recurring consistency issues such as duplicates, missing records, and status mismatches, making enterprise customer investigations more systematic
Stabilized the progress-event delivery layer where events were delayed under traffic spikes, and rolled the change out gradually across 6 regions

achievements.title: Built an AI Preprocessing Pipeline
details: Added an AI preprocessing step for 360° capture data, with asynchronous processing flow and backend status-management APIs
Reflected processing results and status models in API and SDK contracts so clients and backend services followed the same workflow
Strengthened the regional execution flow so preprocessing jobs and status tracking worked reliably across deployment regions

experience.description: Focused on service optimization and building infrastructure for enhanced developer productivity.

achievements.title: Improved Developer Productivity and Test Automation in a Closed DBMS Environment (Tibero)
details: Developed Tibero Docker/TestContainer, eliminating per-developer local test DB setup overhead and reducing team-wide environment configuration costs
Achieved 70% Docker image size reduction (1.5GB → 401MB) by applying zstd compression algorithm and removing unnecessary files
Integrated Tibero TestContainer into CI/CD pipelines, automating database-dependent tests and ensuring consistent test environments
Analyzed Flyway core logic and developed Tibero-specific dialect for automated DDL version control, streamlining schema deployment process
Released 3 internally validated projects as open source, contributing to the expansion of Tibero developer ecosystem

experience.description: Led backend development for MiriCanvas AI Drawing service.

achievements.title: Built AI Image Generation Service Backend from Scratch
details: Scaled from early prototype to production system handling 1M+ monthly image generation requests reliably
Designed asynchronous processing pipeline integrating external AI model APIs (OpenAI, Stability AI)
Integrated DALL·E 3, achieving 40% increase in daily image requests

achievements.title: Optimized Infrastructure Costs, Achieving 20% Monthly Reduction
details: Implemented request classification logic by characteristics (resolution, model) to optimize GPU resource utilization
Applied instance downsizing (g5.2xlarge → g5.xlarge) based on workload analysis
Reduced spot instance setup time by 40% (25min → 15min) through AMI optimization and prewarming strategy

achievements.title: Reduced CDN Costs 80%+ with Lambda@Edge Real-time Image Transformation
details: Implemented Lambda function for real-time PNG → WebP conversion at CloudFront origin response
Achieved 75% average file size reduction through image format conversion, reducing CDN transfer costs by 80%+
Designed architecture enabling gradual migration without modifying existing S3 storage

achievements.title: Resolved Admin Server Concurrency Issues with Redis Distributed Lock
details: Resolved ID collision issues caused by AutoIncrement PK changes using Redis-based distributed lock
Implemented AOP-based automatic retry logic ensuring graceful handling during lock conflicts
Eliminated data loss issues from designer work conflicts, improved concurrency control within legacy constraints
